text:
morgan: heads up — starting cross-service cutover (API / runtime / console / router) in 30m. Pin plan: API v2.3.1, runtime kernel-qt1.4, console 5.8.0. Router header-split staged. Any objections or needs for extra cushion?

alex: LGTM. ops note — suggest staggered router rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m to avoid kv-eviction spike.

emily: console will push asset rev + cache-bust. setting CDN TTL to 60s at T+10m. will update release notes & docs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by morgan: "crosssvc-cutover-789". scheduled in 30m. Pins applied: API=v2.3.1, Runtime=kernel-qt1.4. Rollback window: 45m after cutover. To cancel: `/deploy cancel crosssvc-cutover-789`.

jay: ops ack. observability dashboards ready. alerting thresholds: latency >150ms or error rate >1% sustained for 2m -> trigger rollback. Rollback targets: API -> v2.3.0, Runtime -> kernel-qt1.3.

morgan: quick question — preferred rollback order? runtime -> api -> router -> console?

alex: runtime first, then api, then router, then console. runtime rollback cuts the kernel path that often causes tokenization stalls. we've used that order in last kernel incident.

emily: I'll hold router unpin until canary health checks pass. if canary looks good at +15m we'll unpin router. if not, abort and rollback immediately. :warning:

morgan: cool. who can run final smoke at T-5? @jay @alex

jay: I'll run smoke at T-5. command i'll run: `curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.test/health` and check `x-runtime-kernel` + status headers. will post quick results.

deploy-bot: reminder — change window 00:30-01:15 UTC. CRITICAL: if any service breaches thresholds or dashboards show degradations, run `/deploy rollback crosssvc-cutover-789`. I'll post status updates during rollout.

morgan: thanks all. i'll be on call for the window. ping in this thread for any immediate rollbacks or hotfixes.
